planSteps.description: Create `src/utils/FileMatching.js` to implement fuzzy file matching and search by partial names/extensions
Update `src/agents/FileAgent.js` to parse vague file references and use FileMatching for resolution
Modify `src/utils/ExecutionStateManager.js` to track recently mentioned/accessed files in conversation context
Update `src/agents/IntentAgent.js` to extract file intent from natural language patterns ("this file", "that document", etc.)
Update `src/agents/CommunicationAgent.js` to handle ambiguous matches with clarification prompts to the user
Update `src/messaging/MessagingLayer.js` to pass file context and conversation history to agents
Update `test-agents.js` to test natural language file reference patterns and fuzzy matching edge cases
